# Firebase Security Rules Exposure Checker

> Enter a Firebase project ID to test, with read-only unauthenticated requests, which database or Firestore paths are publicly readable. Nothing uploaded to us.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
